name: 三択回答を並べた設定表
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Targeted correction of LH07-0012. Image1 ORIGINAL source is authority for icon geometry and fine control anatomy. Image2 is the previous generated edit target. Image3 is secondary mock for locked Japanese typography and content. Official pure-white/forest-green/slate design remains binding.
Keep the complete six-row table geometry, all25Japanese text runs, choice labels and exact selected states UNCHANGED. Make only typography correction: the six left row labels and all 可/不可/不明 choice text must become Meiryo REGULAR weight400, logical12px/16px, tracking0, visibly lighter/thinner than current v1. Match ordinary text strokes in image3 saved mock. Keep ONLY the title 利用しやすさ Bold14/24; do not lighten title. Preserve one selected forest-green cell per row: 不明,不明,可,可,不明,不明. White text in selected cells remains legible but REGULAR400. Preserve white canvas/card, borders, slate unselected text, margins and alignment. No added glyphs, no state changes, no new card/row/label. All original source fine control anatomy stays intact.
reviewNotes: v1からrow文字のweightを対象修正し、見出しのみBoldの階層に戻ったことを画像比較で確認。全6row・可/不可/不明・選択順不明/不明/可/可/不明/不明を保持。原版優先segment境界、白面、選択森緑の一貫性も目視確認。exactfont実体/寸法/操作/native/所有者承認未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
